scheme_name: Vidyajyothi Scheme- Financial Aid For Uniforms And Study Materials To PH Students
other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala
The applicant must be a student
The applicant must be studying in a Government or Aided Institution in Kerala
The applicant must be studying in classes from 9th to Post‑Graduation
The applicant must have a disability of 40% or more
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for study materials and uniforms up to ₹3000 per student, varying by class level.
